instructions: Mock of a browser an agent can drive. It serves one fictional page of the Acme Support Portal. No real browser opens.

tools.name: browser_navigate
tools.description: Open a URL. Returns the status and the title of the page.

responses.error: Not found (404): this mock only knows http://127.0.0.1:8000/requests and a request page under it.

tools.name: browser_snapshot
tools.description: Get a text snapshot of the current page, like an accessibility tree.

selector.description: Optional element name to keep, for example button

result.snapshot:
page 'Support Portal - My requests' (http://127.0.0.1:8000/requests)
- heading 'My requests' [level=1]
- button 'Export CSV' [ref=e12]
- textbox 'Filter requests' [ref=e14]
- table 'Requests'
  - row 'SUP-1001 Login code not received - Open - 2026-11-17'
  - row 'SUP-1002 Invoice question - Solved - 2026-11-10'
- link 'Next page' [ref=e20]

tools.name: browser_click
tools.description: Click an element named in the snapshot. Returns what happened.

element.description: Name of the element, for example Export CSV

responses.error: No element with that name on the page.

tools.name: browser_screenshot
tools.description: Take a screenshot of the current page. Returns a file name and size, no image data.

full_page.description: Capture the whole page when true
